messages:
zoe: FYI spotted lots of requests in the org quota spike dashboard that the console shows as project-scoped. looks like attribution mismatch.
matt: can you paste an example req id?
zoe: req=01GZ7Y8KA2Q1JD9B0XYA
leah: pulled the trace. client sent `x-project: project-77` but auth resolver returned project=null and routed to org-default. this is consistent for multipart uploads.
raj: interesting. did we recently change header parsing in the edge proxy?
leah: yes 10.3.01 change: we canonicalize headers and strip duplicates for multipart bodies to avoid memory blowups. looks like we accidentally drop `x-project` when Content-Type is multipart/form-data.
zoe: that explains console/UI confusion: client side shows project X but backend attribution is org. Bad for quota enforcement and CS tickets.
matt: short term: i propose we stop falling back to org-default when a client-supplied project header exists but token lacks claim. instead fail-fast with 400 and clear error message. that'll surface clients doing weird header shenanigans.
raj: agree. add a feature-flag `auth.fail_on_project_mismatch` so we can canary. also add `auth.attribution.provenance` tag to telemetry so we can see header vs claim vs fallback.
leah: i'll add sampling and the provenance tag in the auth layer. schema: `auth.attribution_source` = header|token_claim|fallback. send as tracing attribute and to metrics.
zoe: console change request: show both "client project header" and "auth resolved project" in request details, and colorize when they differ. ops and CS keep opening tickets.
matt: i can do the UI diff (2d). for the server change i'll open a PR to revert permissive fallback and gate it behind the new flag. rollout plan: 1) telemetry + UI patch 2) enable flag at 1% traffic in staging 3) monitor error rate and quota delta 4) increase to 5% then 25% then global if stable.
leah: also add an audit log event `auth.attribution_method` set to the provenance value. ops wants these for postmortem.
raj: add circuit-breaker: if enabling strict mode causes >1% increase in 4xx/5xx we auto-revert flag for that deployment group.
zoe: can we fast-fix the edge behavior? maybe allowlist `x-project` to never be canonicalized away for multipart.
leah: yep i can patch proxy config today: `preserve_headers_for_multipart: ["x-project"]`. low-risk change, deploy to staging first.
matt: sample config for strict mode:```yaml
auth:
  routing_priority: ["token_claim", "header"]
  fallback: "fail" # options: fail | allow
  provenance_sampling_pct: 1
```
raj: owners: leah (auth + proxy), matt (console + server PR), zoe (triage & customer comms). i'll open the incident/issue and link runbook.
auth-bot: incident created: INC-6891234567 3 auth attribution mismatch. owners: leah, matt, zoe. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/auth-attribution-mismatch
zoe: moving to 30m triage. i'll draft a short CS note explaining potential billing attribution blip and asking affected customers to re-send uploads if they hit 400s after fix.
leah: posting patch links in thread once ready. will also add metric `auth.attribution_source.count` with tags.
matt: PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/1129. staging deploy in ~1h.
zoe: thanks all. keep updates here so CS can sync. if anyone notices token reissuance problems, ping immediately.
